role.altitude: The biofuels production manager keeps leading shifts, walking the plant, deciding production and maintenance priorities and resolving process problems with engineers; reading paper logs, pulling figures from the control system, lab and tank gauges, and tracking actions and certificates by hand shrink.
skills_to_grow: Reading historian trends and lab results side by side
role.ambitious_version: A manager who sees a yield drop the same morning and spends the shift fixing it rather than finding it.

tasks.short: Have shift logs written, hold the shift handover, supervise production employees on the plant in the manufacturing of biodiesel, read the logs, plan shift staffing and keep operators' training current.

steps.what: Shift operators write the shift log of events, samples and adjustments
Biofuels production manager holds the shift handover meeting with shift leaders
Biofuels production manager supervises production employees on the plant: reactor, washing and distillation sections
Biofuels production manager reads the shift logs and looks up the readings behind them
Biofuels production manager plans shift staffing and covers absences
Biofuels production manager coaches operators and checks their training and certificates are current

tasks.design: Operators write the shift log in an electronic logbook in the plant's operations system ({OPS_SYSTEM}), where each entry can carry the control system readings at that time, so the manager reads one log and clicks through to the trend. Shift staffing runs in a rostering app that flags shifts below the minimum crew. A training matrix from the HR records reminds the manager before certificates expire. Handover, supervision on the plant and coaching stay with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shift logs were on paper and readings had to be looked up separately in the control room.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic shift logbooks linked to the control system historian, and HR training records with expiry dates.
tasks.still_hard: Judging an operator's readiness to run the plant alone.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing in the handover what the log leaves out.
tasks.altitude: Less reading and roster work; supervision stays hands-on.

reach.learn: Whether the electronic log is as quick as the paper one at night.

evidence.claim: Electronic shift logbooks link entries to control system readings.
Logs and rosters per operator can monitor performance and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: day-to-day supervision of production employees; hiring is separate.

Input contract for s4: shift log entries written by operators in the electronic logbook (s1) with about the effort of the paper log, and readings from the control system historian; s4 is priced on all shifts using it.
Input contract for s6: training and certificate records with expiry dates kept by HR.
Handover, supervision and coaching keep their full or nearly full time; operator time is outside the manager's savings.
research_questions: Do handovers get shorter when the log is read beforehand?

incremental.description: Biofuels production manager agrees log categories with shift leaders.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a small day-shift plant; high: continuous shifts with long logs and many certificates to track.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review production, yield and tank stock, plan runs, manage operations including shipping with loading slots, agree maintenance priorities, review quality assurance results and keep the sustainability mass balance.

steps.what: Biofuels production manager reviews production, yield and tank stock figures
Biofuels production manager plans production runs against orders and feedstock deliveries
Hauliers and barge operators ask for loading slots
Biofuels production manager coordinates shipping: loading slots, tank allocation and shipping papers
Biofuels production manager agrees maintenance priorities with the maintenance lead
Biofuels production manager reviews quality assurance results against the fuel specification
Biofuels production manager keeps the sustainability mass balance of feedstock in and fuel out for certification

tasks.design: A plant dashboard shows production, yield per batch and tank stock from the control system historian and the tank gauges, next to open orders and expected feedstock deliveries from the {ERP}. Hauliers book loading slots in a portal within the slot rules the manager sets, and shipping papers print from the order. Lab results arrive from the LIMS with off-spec values flagged. The mass balance of feedstock in and fuel out is computed from ERP receipts and shipments with their sustainability declarations. Planning, maintenance priorities and quality decisions stay with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Figures sat in the control room, the lab and the ERP, and were combined in spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Historian data in dashboards, slot booking portals and LIMS result feeds.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing between a shipment deadline and a maintenance stop.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which feedstock batch will cause trouble in the reactor.
tasks.altitude: Less compiling; operational decisions stay with the manager.

reach.learn: Whether slot booking cuts waiting at the gate.

evidence.claim: A Dutch wholesaler reports stock down over 20% with availability above 98% after configuring an inventory planning tool (vendor case, not a plant).
Control system historians, tank gauges and lab systems can feed a plant dashboard.
Sustainability certification of biofuels needs a mass balance of certified feedstock and output.

assumptions: Boundary: running the plant day to day; sales contracts are outside.
Input contract for s1: process readings from the control system historian and tank levels from radar gauges on the main tanks; small tanks are dipped and typed.
Input contract for s4: slot bookings by hauliers and barge operators in the portal (s3) with about the effort of a booking mail; about 70% book there; the rest still mail.
Input contract for s6: lab results entered by lab analysts in the LIMS against the fuel specification limits.
Input contract for s7: feedstock receipts and shipments in the {ERP} with their sustainability declarations entered by the logistics planner at receipt.
Maintenance talks keep their full time; haulier time is outside the manager's savings.
unknowns: Whether the LIMS and historian are reachable from the office network.
research_questions: Do off-spec batches get caught earlier?

already_counted.description: Biofuels production manager checks dashboard figures against tank dips when they differ.

incremental.description: Biofuels production manager keeps slot rules and dashboard targets current.
Logistics planner enters sustainability declarations at receipt.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a small plant with few shipments and a simple feedstock mix; high: many barge and truck loadings and mixed certified feedstocks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give safety and environmental instructions, check permits to work, answer questions on procedures, inspect the work floor and record instructions to provide direction that ensures compliance with plant safety, environmental and operational standards.

steps.what: Biofuels production manager provides direction on safety and environmental standards in toolbox meetings
Biofuels production manager checks permits to work and job safety analyses before work starts
Biofuels production manager answers employees' questions about procedures and operational standards

loop.input: An employee's question and the plant's approved procedures and work instructions.
loop.output: The relevant procedure steps, quoted with document number and section.
loop.check: Every answer must quote an approved procedure with its number and section, or it says 'ask your shift leader'; it never answers questions about the live state of the plant.
loop.why_not_simpler: The procedure index uses document titles, not the words operators ask with.

steps.what: Biofuels production manager inspects the work floor and corrects unsafe work
Biofuels production manager records instructions given and follow-up of findings

tasks.design: Toolbox talks, permit checks and floor inspections stay with the manager. An answer desk over the plant's approved procedures answers employees' questions by quoting the procedure section, and refers anything about the live plant to the shift leader. Findings and instructions are recorded on a phone form in the safety system with a photo, and open follow-ups get reminders. No software takes part in any safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure questions came to the manager because the index was hard to search.
tasks.enabler_now: Answer desks that quote approved documents, and mobile safety forms.
tasks.still_hard: Changing habits that are unsafe but have never gone wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Being on the floor when the risky job starts.
tasks.altitude: Fewer procedure questions; safety leadership stays in person.

reach.learn: Which procedures employees ask about most.

evidence.claim: Language models can answer from a fixed set of documents and quote the section used.
Safety records per employee can monitor behaviour and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: directing employees on standards; writing procedures is the safety coordinator's work.
Input contract for s3: approved procedures and work instructions in the document system, kept by the safety coordinator; drafts are excluded.
Input contract for s5: findings entered by the manager on a phone form during rounds.
Toolbox talks, permit checks and inspections keep their full or nearly full time.
unknowns: How many procedure questions reach the manager per week.
research_questions: Do employees use the answer desk at night when the manager is not there?

already_counted.description: Biofuels production manager reviews answers employees flag as wrong.

incremental.description: Biofuels production manager reports unclear procedures to the safety coordinator.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: an experienced crew that rarely asks; high: many new staff and contractors.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hear of conditions affecting safety, efficiency or quality, gather the trends, lab results and maintenance history, confer with technical and supervisory personnel to resolve them, log actions and report serious conditions.

steps.what: Biofuels production manager hears from shift leaders, lab and maintenance about conditions affecting the plant
Biofuels production manager gathers process trends, lab results and maintenance history on the condition
Biofuels production manager confers with technical and supervisory personnel to resolve the condition
Biofuels production manager logs the condition, actions and owners in the action list
Biofuels production manager reports serious conditions to the plant director and, where required, the authority

tasks.design: Each condition gets an issue record in the plant's operations system ({OPS_SYSTEM}) that opens the historian trends for the tags involved, the lab results for the batch and the maintenance history of the equipment, so the manager does not gather them from three places. Actions and owners are logged on the same record with reminders. Conferring with engineers and supervisors and reporting to the director or the authority stay with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trends, lab results and maintenance history had to be collected from separate systems and people.
tasks.enabler_now: Operations systems that link issue records to historian, lab and maintenance data.
tasks.still_hard: Conditions with no clear cause in the data.
tasks.human_edge: Getting operations and maintenance to agree on the fix.
tasks.altitude: Less gathering; problem solving stays with people.

reach.learn: Whether linked records speed up root-cause work.

evidence.claim: Operations systems can link issue records to historian, lab and maintenance data.
Plants covered by major-accident rules must report serious incidents to the authority.

assumptions: Boundary: from a reported condition to actions logged and reported; carrying out repairs is outside.

Input contract for s2: tag trends from the control system historian, batch results entered by lab analysts in the LIMS, and work order history in the maintenance system; the issue record links them by tag, batch and equipment number.
Input contract for s4: action owners close their own actions on the record.
Conferring and reporting keep their full time.
unknowns: How many conditions a week need the manager.
research_questions: Do repeat conditions fall when actions are tracked on one record?

incremental.description: Biofuels production manager keeps tag and equipment links on issue types current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few conditions with simple causes; high: frequent quality and yield issues needing data from several systems.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
